task_instance: Topic research query (one of the skill's own example use cases): 'Best practices for webhook retry logic'. Produced a full multi-source research brief following the skill's exact template (Answer, Confidence, Key Findings by source, Context & Nuance, Sources, Gaps & Unknowns, Recommended Next Steps), using web search as the only available source tier (Tier 4) since internal KB/CRM/chat/email connectors are not available in this office-assistant runtime.
evidence: Ran two WebSearch queries ('webhook retry logic best practices exponential backoff 2026' and 'webhook delivery retry idempotency signature verification best practices'), which returned 9+ distinct sources (Activepieces, HookRay, DEV Community x2, BoldSign, Digital Applied, didit.me, Webalert, etc.) with concrete, cross-corroborated technical findings (exponential backoff formula, jitter, dead-letter queues, idempotency keys, raw-body signature verification). Attempted WebFetch on two additional primary vendor pages (svix.com, hookdeck.com) for deeper verification; both were blocked by the environment's network egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED) -- noted transparently as a limitation in the brief rather than silently omitted, consistent with the skill's own 'be transparent about limitations' guidance. Synthesized all findings into /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__customer-research@office-assistant/research-brief.md, which follows the skill's required 'Research: [Topic]' template exactly: a direct Answer, a Medium confidence rating with justification (per the skill's Tier 4 = Low-Medium confidence guidance), Key Findings grouped and attributed by source, Context & Nuance, a numbered Sources list with URLs and per-source contribution, Gaps & Unknowns (explicitly noting Tiers 1-3 internal sources were unavailable in this runtime), and Recommended Next Steps. Verified the deliverable by reading back the written file content and confirming every required template section is present and populated with real, attributed findings rather than placeholders. The task exercised the skill's core deliverable (a synthesized, attributed, confidence-scored research brief) fully within the office-assistant runtime's granted abilities (text file read/write, web search/fetch); no code execution, binary output, or connector/MCP access was needed to accomplish the core intent -- those are only needed for the skill's optional Tier 1-3 internal-source lookups, which the skill itself treats as conditional ('if connected') and has an explicit fallback workflow for (Step 4: Handle Insufficient Sources) that this run followed.
